correctness.rationale: The uniform partial-bijection completion lemma converts conditional cycles into harmonic expectation plus closed prescribed cycles. Each rank-pattern triple permits explicit exact one-, two- and three-cycle counts; equation (1) produces the six displayed affine expressions. Boundaries n=3 and i=1,n-2 are included, with H0=0. A replayable standard-library checker passed all 66282 finite exact checks, not substituted for proof.

originality.rationale: Based on actual semantic publication searches and comparisons to relevant preprints, the location-refined six-pattern cycle-count covariance is not implied by the inspected peak/descent-set results (which do not distinguish 132 from 231) or pairwise inversion covariances. Prior single-cycle conditional pattern means do not give cycle-count weighting across all cycle counts. Aggregate peak/valley covariances are explicitly not claimed novel; residual source access/implicit-coverage risks are named.
residual_risks: Complete Gessel--Reutenauer 1993 primary text not inspected; a general marked-descent/cycle method might entail unprinted consequences.

The existing published inversion-cycle identity might combine with further higher-order formulas outside the searched corpus to imply the exact table.
Pattern/cycle-count joint results under alternative terminology or unpublished sources may have been missed; negative search is not proof of originality.

value.rationale: A complete natural six-class classification resolves how cycle count co-varies with local three-point order, exhibiting nontrivial affine location effects and a rank-two covariance array. The distinct peak/valley subtypes have opposite location slopes that cancel in older aggregated statistics, demonstrating information unavailable from descent-set marginals. This is an exact all-size dependence law with motivated statistical use, not a routine restatement of the general projection lemma.
